title: Open brief
summary: No product, no copy, no palette given. The whole brief is: invent something and build its website; make it memorable. This is what each model does when nobody tells it what to make.
watchFor: What did it choose to invent, and is the idea any good?
Originality versus the generic SaaS template
Typography, colour and motion with no constraints
Does the phone layout keep the personality?
interaction: Scroll the whole page at a fixed speed on desktop and on a phone; open the menu on the phone if there is one.
noun: a site for an invented product
